**Missing IMEISV after an IMEISV request**

| | |
|---|---|
| Group | NAS / 5GMM common procedures / Security mode control procedure |
| Tags | negative, security |
| Verdict class | WARN |
| Requires | Rel-15 |
| Up to | 20s at the default `--per-test-timeout` |
| Phase | main |
| Needs | NG Setup, registration |

## Clauses

- TS 24.501 5.4.2.2 IMEISV request (Rel-15 onward, wording unchanged through Rel-19)
- TS 33.501 6.7.2 step 2b (Rel-15 onward; Rel-15: an unnumbered paragraph in V15.0.0, step 2b by V15.20.0; the sentence on the PEI is unchanged through V19.7.0)

The quoted normative text and the release history of each clause are in the check's [provenance](https://github.com/grewelltech/orbit/blob/main/docs/conformance/provenance/NAS-SMC-IMEISV-REQUEST.md).
